stalls.en: Xiao Wang Steamed Minced Pork with Pickles in Broth
foodsEn: Pork with pickled cucumber in clear broth
stalls.where: 華西街 17 之 4 號（153 號攤）
stalls.summaryZh: 招牌滷肉飯顏色深黑，吃起來卻不死鹹、油而不膩，清湯瓜仔肉帶胡椒香可續湯；近 50 年老攤，連續多年米其林必比登。週二公休。
stalls.summaryEn: The signature braised pork rice is very dark but not overly salty or greasy. The clear pork-and-pickle soup has a peppery aroma, with refills. A stall of nearly 50 years with Bib Gourmand recognition for many years running. Closed Tuesdays.

stalls.where: 華西街 17-2 號（161 號攤）
stalls.summaryZh: 營業超過 65 年，刈包夾帶皮五花，可選肥或瘦，配酸菜和花生粉香氣十足；常排隊，米其林必比登推薦。週一公休。
stalls.summaryEn: Open for more than 65 years. The bun holds skin-on pork belly (ask for fatty or lean) with pickled greens and peanut powder. Often a line. Michelin Bib Gourmand. Closed Mondays.

stalls.summaryZh: 招牌是用豬頸肉的菊花肉麵，味道樸實帶古早味，用餐時間常客滿；只開平日白天到傍晚，週末公休。米其林必比登推薦。
stalls.summaryEn: Known for noodles with pork cheek meat ('chrysanthemum meat'), simple and old-fashioned in flavour. Usually full at mealtimes. Open weekday afternoons only, closed weekends. Michelin Bib Gourmand.

stalls.where: 華西街 19 號（151 號攤）
stalls.summaryZh: 招牌是鋪滿鮮蚵和蔥花的滷肉蓋飯，蚵仔新鮮無腥味，滷肉以藥材慢滷、滑順不油，在 IG 上很紅。
stalls.summaryEn: Famous for braised pork rice piled with fresh oysters and scallions. The oysters taste clean and fresh, and the pork is slow-braised with herbs, smooth and not greasy. Very popular on Instagram.

stalls.en: Qing Quan Hao Mushroom Congee & Oyster Omelet
stalls.where: 華西街 19 之 3 號（137 號攤）
stalls.summaryZh: 飄香約 50 年，香菇粥湯清不鹹、米粒微綿，價格很便宜；蚵仔煎外酥內Q、醬汁甜鹹平衡。週一、二公休。
stalls.summaryEn: Around 50 years old. The mushroom congee is clear and not salty, with soft rice, and very cheap. The oyster omelet is crisp outside and chewy inside with a balanced sauce. Closed Mondays and Tuesdays.

華西街夜市美食（食尚玩家）

stalls.summaryZh: 現炒鍋氣足、蒜香重，牛肉滑嫩、青菜爽脆，份量大、價格實在；牛雜湯可續湯。
stalls.summaryEn: Stir-fried to order with strong wok aroma and plenty of garlic. Tender beef, crisp greens, big portions and fair prices. The beef offal soup comes with refills.

sources.title: 華西街夜市美食（食尚玩家）
艋舺500元美食挑戰（旅圖 ReadyGo／LINE TODAY）

stalls.summaryZh: 桂圓米糕粥香氣濃、甜而不膩，花生湯綿密；下午開賣、常排隊，熱門品項很快賣完。
stalls.summaryEn: The longan sticky-rice porridge is fragrant and sweet without being cloying, and the peanut soup is creamy. Opens in the afternoon, often has a line, and popular items sell out fast.

stalls.summaryZh: 華西街唯一留下的老冰果室，木瓜牛奶現打、果香濃又不會粉粉的，甜度自然；週四公休。
stalls.summaryEn: The last old-style fruit parlour on Huaxi Street. Papaya milk is blended to order, rich in fruit flavour without a powdery feel, and naturally sweet. Closed Thursdays.

stalls.summaryZh: 從擔仔麵攤起家的華西街老字號海鮮餐廳，蝦捲現捲、龍蝦來自澎湖，曾獲米其林一星。
stalls.summaryEn: Huaxi Street institution that grew from a danzai noodle stall into a seafood restaurant; rolled-to-order shrimp rolls and Penghu lobster. Earned a Michelin star in 2019.
